MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

3. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 12
   D. 11

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 23
   D. 17

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 41

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 73

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

14. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

16. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 12

17. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

18. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 1

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

20. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

21. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

22. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33

25. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)

26. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24

   D. 5

27. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

28. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

29. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

30. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1
